_notes: Lexeme blocklists for battery stimulus text (WEEK_PLAN authoring rule: no giveaway vocabulary).
Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, applied by src/battery/validate_battery.py to the
'global' applies to every item; 'per_value' lists apply to items whose value_A or value_B matches.
Adding a value or a lexeme is a one-line edit to 'per_value'.
Seed lists are exactly as specified in the session task spec (2026-07-30); inflectional variants
(e.g. 'punished', 'forgiven') are NOT auto-derived — extend lists explicitly.
'pending_researcher' marks values whose lists are not yet ratified; the validator surfaces these
as researcher-decision flags (non-blocking) on every run that touches them.
